findings.evidence: Scratch probe (vitest --project conformance, BASE code @ fb441a514): P3 ESM /alias.mjs (`const g = globalThis; g[k] = v`), /logical.mjs (`globalThis[k] ??= v`), /forin.mjs (`for (globalThis[k] in o)`), /objdestr.mjs (`({a: globalThis[k]} = …)`), /setter.mjs (`globalThis.__defineSetter__(k, v)`) -> all THROW module-loader.esm-global-function-assignment at load today.
findings.summary: ADR-0444 §1 moves logical assignment, for-in and object-destructuring targets, `__defineSetter__`, prefix/`--` updates and tracked-alias runtime keys from load-time to runtime, but Acceptance 4 and the conformance file carry no 'Function'-key case for them; an impl that drops the load-time flag there without wrapping would silently let a runtime 'Function' key replace the host constructor. Add these sites to Acceptance 4 / writeSites, or keep them load-time.

Acceptance 6 says folded 'Function' keys reject 'before any statement runs', but the cited resolver tables put the Function write as each module's first statement and assert only the thrown feature; an impl that routes literal computed 'Function' keys through the runtime helper would still pass. Add an observable earlier statement to one ESM and one CJS folded-key row.
CJS Parity 3 checks coercion order only for assignment, compound and defineProperty. `++`, Reflect.set, delete and toPrimitive->Symbol are ESM-only, though cjs.ts has its own rewrite path.

Acceptance 1 claims descriptors equal Node's, including restore of an existing global's descriptor. The case prints only the restored value and the fresh stub's `enumerable`, so a changed writable/configurable/enumerable after restore goes unseen.

The file-size ratchet leaves 4 lines free in esm.ts and 12 in cjs.ts, so the helper and site wrapping must live in a new module (with a dir-owner check if needed). This is an implementation-planning note only.

ADR-0444 says 'nothing overturned' but replaces goal.md's agent carrier decision ('a computed key bound to a Symbol value is provably never Function'). It names that decision only under Alternatives. goal.md is correctly left unchanged, and the ledger re-chart (ledger.md:10) records the widening. The overturn could be stated explicitly (DEC-2, advisory).
